name: Duplicati
title: Duplicati Backup
description: Encrypted backup solution with support for cloud storage (Google Drive, AWS S3, OneDrive, etc.)

env.label: Settings Encryption Key
env.name: SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.description: Encrypts Duplicati's settings database; at least 8 alphanumeric characters (generate with: openssl rand -hex 24). Keep it: the settings can't be read without it.

env.label: Web UI Password
env.name: DUPLICATI__WEBSERVICE_PASSWORD
env.description: Password for the Duplicati web UI

note: After deployment, configure cloud storage backends and backup schedules via web interface.
